description_en: Enables or disables the pay-as-you-go billing method for specified features
description_zh: 打开或关闭指定功能的按量付费
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-post-pay-module-switch --post-pay-instance-id 'postpay-sas-**' --post-pay-module-switch '{"VUL":1,"CSPM":0}' --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-0016e04115b --post-paid-host-auto-bind 1 --post-paid-host-auto-bind-version 3 --post-pay-module-switch-obj Agentless=1 Rasp=1 Vul=1 Cspm=1 CtdrStorage=1 BasicService=1 Sdk=1 Serverless=1 PostHost=1 AiDigital=1 AntiRansomware=1 Ctdr=1 WebLock=1 --edr-module-switch EDR_HOST_USAGE=2 AutoBind=0 --dry-run true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyPostPayModuleSwitch

parameters.help_en:
The pay-as-you-go instance ID. This parameter is required.

Invoke the [DescribeVersionConfig](~~DescribeVersionConfig~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费实例ID，必须填写。

调用[DescribeVersionConfig](~~DescribeVersionConfig~~)接口以获取该参数
parameters.name: post_pay_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The switch status of the pay-as-you-go modules. The value is a JSON string. Valid values:
Key:
VUL: Vulnerability fixing module
CSPM: Cloud Security Posture Management module
AGENTLESS: Agentless detection module
SERVERLESS: Serverless security module
CTDR: Cloud Threat Detection and Response module
POST_HOST: Host and container security module
SDK: Malicious file detection SDK module
RASP: Application protection module
CTDR_STORAGE: Log management module
ANTI_RANSOMWARE: Anti-ransomware management
Value: 0 indicates disabled, and 1 indicates enabled.

The values of modules that are not specified remain unchanged.

<notice>This parameter has the same meaning as the PostPayModuleSwitchObj parameter. If both parameters are specified, the value of PostPayModuleSwitch takes precedence.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
按量付费模块开关状态，格式为JsonString，取值：
Key：
VUL：漏洞修复模块
CSPM：云安全态势管理模块
AGENTLESS：无代理检测模块
SERVERLESS：Serverless安全模块
CTDR：威胁分析与响应模块
POST_HOST：主机及容器安全模块
SDK：恶意文件检测SDK模块
RASP：应用防护模块
CTDR_STORAGE：日志管理模块
ANTI_RANSOMWARE：防勒索管理
Value：0表示关闭，1表示开启

未传值的模块值不会变化。

<notice>与PostPayModuleSwitchObj字段含义相同，当二者同时存在时，以PostPayModuleSwitch的值为准。></notice>
parameters.name: post_pay_module_switch
